title: unknown occasion string returns empty array instead of an error
observed: occasion='BanquetXYZ' (not in the documented allowed set) returns [] with no error. Mechanism: the input schema validates occasion's TYPE but not its VALUE. occasion=12345 (number) -> MCP -32602 input validation error; occasion='' -> treated as no filter (5 results); occasion='Happy Hours' (valid) -> 5 results. Contrast: city='nyc' (unsupported) is rejected with a descriptive message ('Unsupported city ... Supported: new-york'). A typo'd occasion ('date-nite') therefore fails silently with no hint.
expected: unknown occasion values are rejected with a message listing the allowed values, like unsupported cities are — not a silent empty array

negative_control.result: disproof attempt: find an invalid occasion STRING that errors (which would kill the 'no value validation' theory). Empty string is treated as no-filter (n=5); no invalid string value errors — only wrong-type values do. Theory survives.
